votes.quote: **The bug:** `escapeCsv` wraps a value containing a double quote in quotes, but doesn't double the quotes inside it. So `say "hi"` becomes `"say "hi""`, which CSV parsers can't read correctly.

votes.label: reported
votes.quote: `escapeCsv` wraps a value containing a double quote in quotes, but doesn't double the quotes inside it. So `say "hi"` becomes `"say "hi""`, which CSV parsers can't read correctly. Standard CSV (RFC 4180) expects `"say ""hi"""`.
